name: Geographic Map
description: US choropleth of a tape measure by state; click a state to cross-filter.

channel.description: Widgets connected to the same channel share data (the selected deal and the active filters) between each other.
channel.title: Communication Channel

contextKey.description: Which channel value selects the universe (deal name today; portfolio id / cusip tomorrow).
contextKey.title: Context Key

filterKey.description: Channel key this map publishes when a state is clicked, and reads to reflect the active state selection.
filterKey.title: Filter Key

schemaKey.description: Logical geo scenario resolved by GraphQL. Returns a render-ready ECharts map option (choropleth) with a visualMap.
schemaKey.title: Schema Key

emptyStateText.description: Message shown when the scenario returns no map (e.g. nothing selected on the channel yet).
emptyStateText.title: Empty State Text

showTitle.description: Show the map's title row (icon + label) above the plot.
showTitle.title: Show Title

titleText.description: Overrides the map title. Leave blank to use the scenario title from GraphQL.
titleText.title: Custom Title Text
